name: wobbo-bridge
description: Connects coding agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, ...) to the Wobbo app.

scripts.build:plugin: bun run build && mkdir -p plugin/bin && rm -f plugin/bin/claude-buddy-bridge plugin/bin/wobbo-bridge && cp dist/wobbo-bridge plugin/bin/wobbo-bridge
scripts.build:universal: bun build src/main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/wobbo-bridge-arm64 && bun build src/main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/wobbo-bridge-x64 && lipo -create -output dist/wobbo-bridge dist/wobbo-bridge-arm64 dist/wobbo-bridge-x64
